title: Adic formal smoothness for the explicit restricted residue action
statement: Let $A_0,A$ be commutative local rings, $E$ a commutative algebra over $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$, and $n$ an ideal of $E$. Let $\alpha:A_0\to A$ be local and induce a bijective residue map $e:k_0\to k$. If $E$ is formally smooth over $k$ for the $n$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], then it is formally smooth over $k_0$ for the same topology with the explicitly constructed structure map $k_0\xrightarrow e k\to E$. All three carriers may have independent universes.

proof.text: Turn the bijective residue map into a ring equivalence. For a square-zero k₀-test algebra give it a k-action via the inverse equivalence. Scalar compatibility of a map is equivalent for these actions, and neither the ideal power bound nor the quotient equality changes. Apply the given lifting property and restrict the resulting lift to k₀.

To adjust test universes, take the k-subalgebra generated by chosen representatives of every quotient image of E. It is small in max(v,w). Intersect with the test ideal, whose square stays zero, and factor E through the resulting quotient using its injective map to the test quotient. Shrink the subalgebra, apply the original lifting property, and include its lift into the test algebra. For smaller test universes use ULift and transport back.
